_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Looking up the building in HPD's records

annotations.title: Look up a NYC building by address

description: Finds a New York City residential building in HPD's records by borough, house number and street, and returns its registration status (valid, expired or missing), open filing violations, apartment count and Woodpecker's yearly price for it. Use when the user gives an address.

borough.description: Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Manhattan or Staten Island

house_number.description: House number as on the building, like 787 or 100-02

street.description: Street name, like East 56 Street or Bushwick Avenue

name: lookup_nyc_building
title: Look up a NYC building by address
